zh.name: 「石心十人」诡弈砂金（完整）
zh.desc: 代码受到影响后的完整投影。参照本体为星际和平公司「战略投资部」的高级干部，「石心十人」之一。借由基石分得「存护」令使的权能，以身作骰，置之死地而后生。

skill_list.skill_desc: 对指定我方单体造成虚数属性伤害。
连续对我方随机单体造成少量虚数属性伤害。
对我方全体造成少量虚数属性伤害，并减少我方全体的能量。

召唤【「所有或一无所有」】并使我方单体进入赌局，每个【「所有或一无所有」】每次受到进入赌局的我方目标攻击时，会使其获得1个随机1到6的点数，并在生命值降为1后获得【<u>时来</u>】效果，首个【「所有或一无所有」】每次受到攻击时会使赌局的赔率翻倍。进入赌局的我方单体回合结束时，点数低于诡弈砂金视为输掉赌局并受到攻击；点数高于诡弈砂金视为赢得赌局且终结技被激活。同时使没有进入赌局的我方目标陷入【观局勿语】状态，赌局结束后解除。

280340111.name: 时来
280340111.desc: 受到进入赌局的目标攻击时必定产生6的点数，并在赌局结束时施放【败罚】。

en.name: Ten Stonehearts: Aventurine of Stratagems (Complete)
en.desc: A complete projection produced by compromised codes. The referent entity is a senior manager in the IPC Strategic Investment Department and one of the Ten Stonehearts. Using his Cornerstone, he obtained a share of the authority of an Emanator of Preservation. He throws his own body into the game as a die, ready to face death in order to walk away alive.

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals Imaginary DMG to a single target.
Deals successive minor Imaginary DMG to random targets.
Deals minor Imaginary DMG to all targets and reduce all targets' Energy.

Summons "All or Nothing" and makes a single target enter the Gamble. Every time an "All or Nothing" is attacked by a target in the Gamble, the target that launched the attack will receive a random number between 1 and 6. When HP is reduced to 1, gains <u>Influx of Fortuity</u>. Each time the first "All or Nothing" is attacked, doubles the odds of the Gamble. After a target that is in the Gamble has finished their turn, targets with numbers lower than "Aventurine of Stratagems" are considered to have lost the Gamble and will be attacked, while those with a number higher than "Aventurine of Stratagems" are considered to have won the Gamble and will have their Ultimate activated. At the same time, targets that have not entered the Gamble are afflicted with the "Look, Don't Speak" status, which is dispelled when the Gamble ends.

280340111.name: Influx of Fortuity
280340111.desc: When this unit is attacked by a target that has entered the Gamble, this unit always generates a roll of 6, and uses "Punishment of Defeat" when the Gamble ends.

skill_list.skill_desc: Summons "All or Nothing" and makes all targets enter the gamble. Every time an "All or Nothing" is attacked, the target that launched the attack will receive a random number between 1 and 6. When HP is reduced to 1, gains <u>Influx of Fortuity</u>. Each time the first "All or Nothing" is attacked, doubles the odds of the Gamble. The next time "Aventurine of Stratagems" takes a turn, targets with numbers lower than "Aventurine of Stratagems" are considered to have lost the bet and will be attacked, while targets with numbers higher than "Aventurine of Stratagems" are considered to have won the bet and will have their Ultimates activated.

280340111.name: Influx of Fortuity
280340111.desc: When this unit is attacked by a target that has entered the Gamble, this unit always generates a roll of 6, and uses "Punishment of Defeat" when the Gamble ends.

skill_list.skill_desc: Summons "All or Nothing," multiplies the numbers received, and makes all targets enter the gamble. Every time an "All or Nothing" is attacked, the target that launched the attack will receive a random number between 1 and 6. When HP is reduced to 1, gains <u>Influx of Fortuity</u>. Each time the first "All or Nothing" is attacked, doubles the odds of the Gamble. The next time "Aventurine of Stratagems" takes a turn, if the sum of all targets' numbers is lower than that of "Aventurine of Stratagems," they are considered to have lost the bet and will be attacked. If the sum of all targets' numbers is higher than that of "Aventurine of Stratagems," they are considered to have won the bet and will have their Ultimates activated.

280340111.name: Influx of Fortuity
280340111.desc: When this unit is attacked by a target that has entered the Gamble, this unit always generates a roll of 6, and uses "Punishment of Defeat" when the Gamble ends.

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals Imaginary DMG to a target that lost the Gamble, with a high chance of inflicting Imprisonment on the attacked target.
Deals Imaginary DMG to all targets that lost the Gamble, with a high chance of inflicting Imprisonment on the attacked targets.

The initial odds for the gamble is 1, up to a maximum of 4. Every time a target wins the gamble, they receive a number of <u>Fenge's Gift</u> stacks equal to the odds. Every time a target loses the gamble, they receive a number of <u>Fenge's Curse</u> stacks equal to the odds.

280340112.name: Fenge's Gift
280340112.desc: Each stack increases the DMG dealt.

skill_list.skill_desc: The initial odds for the gamble is 1, up to a maximum of 8. Every time a target wins the gamble, they receive a number of <u>Fenge's Gift</u> stacks equal to the odds. 280340112.desc: Each stack increases the DMG dealt.
